visualCharacteristics.colorScheme: light (white card under a grey title bar)
visualCharacteristics.imagePattern: portrait ticket image (5/12) with rotated vertical game-number label
visualCharacteristics.structure: image cell | info cell of label:value rows separated by grey rules + optional chevron link

contentPattern:
One row, two cells. Cell 1:

Game #{n}

(rendered as a rotated vertical label) followed by the ticket image (alt = ticket name). Cell 2: one paragraph per info row, label in : '

Top prize: $675,000

', '

Prizes Available: $4, $6, ...

', '

Overall chance of winning a prize: 1 in 3.74

', then optionally '

SEE ALL TOP PRIZES REMAINING

'. Any row may be omitted.
reuseGuidance: Use for Scratch 'n Win ticket detail pages: ticket image with vertical game number beside rule-separated prize info. Place in a section styled ticket-detail directly after the H1 + price default content.
